name: Photo mode: camera, framing rules and counting
body: A key (C / gamepad) raises the camera to the player's eye with free look; a shutter key takes the photo. A photo counts a sight when it is in the viewfinder frame, close enough, not occluded (raycast) and, for a `together` sight, the companion is in the shot too. No progress is blocked.
acceptance_criteria: Framing rules unit-tested headless where possible
